messages.content: What is NeurionForge AI Studio?
NeurionForge AI Studio is a local-first desktop and web platform for running open-weight LLMs and fine-tuning LoRA adapters directly on your own hardware.
Where do my model weights and data get stored in AI Studio?
All model weights, LoRA adapters, and dataset files are stored locally on your machine (such as in D:/models) to ensure full data privacy and zero cloud dependency.
Does NeurionForge AI Studio require an NVIDIA GPU?
No, AI Studio supports optimized CPU inference through quantized GGUF models, while also leveraging GPU acceleration when available.
How do I fine-tune a model in NeurionForge AI Studio?
You can upload a JSONL dataset, select hyperparameters like LoRA rank and epochs in the Fine-Tuning Studio, and run the training process with real-time loss tracking.
What fine-tuning methods are supported?
AI Studio supports Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) with LoRA and QLoRA for fast, low-memory adaptation of open-source language models.
Can I export my fine-tuned adapter to GGUF format?
Yes, once fine-tuning completes, you can merge your LoRA adapter with the base model and export it as a GGUF file for local inference.
What quantization format does AI Studio recommend by default?
AI Studio recommends 4-bit quantization (such as Q4_K_M) as the default for an optimal balance between generation quality, memory usage, and execution speed.
What communication protocol is used for token streaming in AI Studio?
AI Studio uses WebSockets for real-time, token-by-token streaming and training log output instead of latency-heavy polling.
What is KV-cache reuse in AI Studio?
KV-cache reuse preserves the key-value context of previous conversation turns, avoiding full prompt re-processing on every user turn.
What models can I run locally with AI Studio?
You can run any open-weight model distributed in GGUF format, including Qwen2.5, Llama 3, Mistral, and custom fine-tunes.
Is there any subscription or API cost to use NeurionForge AI Studio?
No, NeurionForge AI Studio is completely free and self-hosted with no paid third-party API dependencies.
What is the role of the FastAPI server in AI Studio?
The FastAPI server manages model lifecycles, streams inference via WebSockets, executes training jobs in the background, and interfaces with SQLite for metadata.
How does AI Studio manage system memory?
AI Studio uses lazy model loading and automatic idle unloading to free RAM and VRAM when models are not in active use.
What features are included in the AI Studio Inference Studio?
The Inference Studio includes model discovery, one-click loading and unloading, interactive streaming chat, system prompt editing, and generation performance metrics.
Can I compare fine-tuned models side-by-side?
Yes, AI Studio includes a model comparison view allowing you to test the same prompt against base and fine-tuned models concurrently.
What is Agent mode in NeurionForge AI Studio?
Agent mode enables local models to execute sandboxed filesystem and terminal tools with a diff review panel and user confirmation guardrails.
How does AI Studio prevent dangerous terminal commands in Agent mode?
Destructive shell commands require explicit user approval in the review panel before execution and are strictly sandboxed to the project directory.
How are training logs streamed to the frontend?
Training jobs broadcast progress, current step, and loss metrics over dedicated WebSocket channels to render live loss curves in the UI.
What is the relationship between NeurionForge and AI Studio?
AI Studio (aistudio.neurionforge.com) is the first product created under the NeurionForge umbrella brand.
How can I get started with AI Studio?
Download or point AI Studio to your local GGUF models in D:/models, launch the interface, and start chatting or fine-tuning immediately.
